programmes.d: Ian and Barbara are accidentally taken into Smithers' laboratory and, while the Doctor and Susan face a hazardous journey to reach them, they witness the deadly effects of DN6 first hand.
The tiny time travelers take action.
The Doctor and his companions arrive in a London very different from what they remember.
The Doctor and Ian are captured and taken to the Dalek ship.
Hiding on board the Dalek spaceship, Ian is taken to the mines of Bedfordshire.
The Doctor, Susan and David discover a nearby firebomb, left by Robomen to destroy London.
Ian and his friend Larry are chased by the Slyther, protecting the Bedfordshire mines.
Barbara realizes how to control the Robomen and orders an attack on the Daleks.

The Doctor is mistaken for a murdered lyre player and targeted by an assassin.
Barbara is sold as a slave and Ian is to be trained as a gladiator.
Poppaea plans to poison Barbara who has become the object of Nero's affections.
Inspired by the Doctor, Nero sets Rome ablaze.
The TARDIS is drawn to Vortis.
Antlike Zarbi capture Barbara.
The Doctor seeks the Animus.
Butterflylike Menoptera want Vortis.
Both Menoptera and Zarbi want Vortis.
Barbara intervenes in the battle.
The Doctor and his companions are horrified to discover they are exhibits in the museum.
The enslaved Xeron race sense an opportunity to topple their Morok invaders.
With the Doctor held captive, his companions try to prevent him becoming an exhibit.
Ian orders the Doctor's revival as the Xerons' revolution begins to gather pace.
Ian and Vicki are trapped by tentacled creatures on the planet Aridius.
The Doctor and his friends have been given shelter from the Daleks by the Aridians.
The Daleks pursue the TARDIS through time and space.
With the Daleks in pursuit, the TARDIS lands in what appears to be a haunted house.
The Daleks follow the TARDIS to the jungle world of Mechanus.
The Doctor and his friends are taken prisoner by the Mechonoids.
The TARDIS lands on the English coast in 1066.
The Doctor is held prisoner by the Monk in the monastery.
Steven and Vicki discover an atomic bazooka.
Discovering the Monk's plan, the Doctor is determined to stop him meddling.
